For visitors

Members only. The schedule page says you must be a member and sign up for each ride, and to ask the club about a free one-month trial. Helmets are required. Only Class 1 e-bikes are allowed. Riders under 18 need a parent or guardian in the membership.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the start time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Levels A to D, with B* and C* in between. Each ride lists its level. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at @btcnj the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the BTCNJ Club Rides group ride

BTCNJ Club Rides is a road and e-bikes welcome group ride in Glen Rock, NJ. Schedule: Rides most days, with the most on Saturdays and Sundays. Each ride's start time, place, pace, distance and level are on the club's public ride schedule. Rides set off 15 minutes after the listed time, after sign-in. Sign-up is required, from Varies by ride (often the Glen Rock Duck Pond, the Ridgewood Starbucks, Campgaw Mountain in Mahwah or a train station lot).

A Bergen County club that posted 28 rides in a 31-day stretch this fall, from 8-mile C rides to a 100-mile century. Rides start at commuter lots, parks and coffee shops across Bergen, Passaic, Essex and Morris counties, and sometimes in Rockland County, New York.
